mapper.select: SELECT di.item_id, di.dict_code, di.item_value, di.item_label, di.sort_order, di.status FROM sys_dict_item di INNER JOIN sys_dict d ON di.dict_code = d.dict_code WHERE d.status = 1 AND di.status = 1 ORDER BY di.dict_code, di.sort_order

SELECT di.item_id, di.dict_code, di.item_value, di.item_label, di.sort_order, di.status FROM sys_dict_item di INNER JOIN sys_dict d ON di.dict_code = d.dict_code WHERE d.status = 1 AND di.status = 1 AND di.dict_code = #{dictCode} ORDER BY di.sort_order
